# Edva

Edva (`.dva`) is a statically typed, expression-oriented systems language with significant indentation, **zero reserved keywords**, unboxed two-slot ramifications, arena-backed memory management, and a self-hosted LLVM 18 compiler.

## Core language invariants

| Invariant | Formal Specification |
|---|---|
| **Source suffix & encoding** | UTF-8 text in `.dva` files; space-only indentation (`E1011` on tabs) |
| **No reserved keywords** | All control flow, branching, iteration, and returns use symbolic operators (`|`, `[...]`, `@`, `-->`, `--^`, `>--`, `--|`); directives use `#` (`#type`, `#use`, `#public`, `#private`, `#foreign`, `#export`, `#packed`, `#align`, `#size`, `#!`) |
| **Bindings & mutability** | Immutable by default (`x = v`); explicit mutability/rebinding via trailing primes (`x' = v`) or marked module globals (`::g = v`). Inline `x: T = v` is forbidden (`E2009`) |
| **Separate signatures** | Function types are declared on a separate line (`f: A, B => R`) preceding `f = a, b => body`. Unannotated functions use Hindley-Milner-style unification and **never default unknown types to `Int`** (`E3103` / `E3128`) |
| **Fixed 64-bit `Int`** | `Int` is strictly 64-bit signed (`i64`) on all targets (including 32-bit `wasm32`); only `Addr` scales with target pointer width |
| **Strings vs Builders** | `String` is an immutable 16-byte `{ i64 len, ptr data }` fat pointer with NUL-reserved tail (`data[len] == 0`) and 16-bit arena generation tag (`E4010` on stale read); `Builder` (`{cap}`) is a 24-byte mutable buffer frozen in $O(1)$ via `+b` |
| **Ramifications (Rams)** | Four static two-slot algebraic layouts replace booleans, options, and exceptions: `<>` (`i1` flag), `<T|>` (option), `<|E>` (fallible), `<T|E>` (unboxed `{ i1, i64 }` result) |
| **Definite initialization** | Forward-declared records (`r: Rec`) are never zero-filled implicitly; every field must be written before reading (`E3130`) |
| **No GC, no RTTI** | Memory uses scoped bump arenas and stack values; closures are `{ ptr fn_ptr, ptr env_ptr }`; `Type` exists strictly at compile time (`#!`) and is erased before codegen |

| 11 | [Arrays, Slices & Maps](reference/types/array.qmd) | Growable arrays (`T{}`), non-owning slices (`T[]`), associative hash tables (`K ^ V`), and snapshot iteration |
